ops.title: Phase T — thread the unwired primitives
ops.description:
An edge nobody writes is an edge no ranker can traverse. Four choke points cover ~80% of the 40-row audit.

T1 `notes.Client` as the single graph reader — collapse `internal/cli/blockers.go:59`, all of `internal/cli/hierarchy.go`, `internal/fusefs/authority.go:251-280` onto the nine zero-caller reverse-index methods; add `TaskChildren` and a cycle-safe transitive supersede-head resolver (`SupersededBy` is a slice, so chains converge and loop; `ListNotes(ctx,false,false)` hides the chain it must walk).
T2 `internal/cli/dto.go` as the single projection — MCP always requests `--json`, so one file feeds CLI + MCP + hooks. All additive; `superseded_by` is a silently-truncating scalar today.
T3 new writers: `task link`/`unlink`, `investigation follow-up`/`supersede`. Land `cc-notes mcp --list-tools` plus a plugin-side equality test FIRST — `CC_NOTES_TOOLS` in `plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py:98-142` is hand-mirrored and not machine-enforced, so a new tool silently drops out of the hook approval map.
T4 the open-findings gate (see note `acd2aac` §3).
T5 `StatusReport` as a real orientation surface; `session.py:24` collapses two `task list` calls into one `status`.
T6 hooks write edges — `workflow.py:392` auto-links the claimed task to HEAD, `record.py:1026` auto-adds a follow-up.
T7 tasks enter the search corpus.

FROZEN: `notes/relevant.go`. Every relevant-side change anyone would propose IS the graph ranker; an interim version is guaranteed double work.

ops.text: The three private duplicates are gone and notes.Client is the only reverse-index implementation
task list --json carries type, parent, sprint, project, blocked_by, blocks and criteria counts from one TasksBlockingIndex pass
note show --json carries superseded_by as an array, plus supersedes, live_head and verified_commit
A new MCP tool absent from CC_NOTES_TOOLS fails a machine-enforced test
investigation confirm errors with open findings and passes with --force, and the skills sweep is done
A task is findable by a phrase that appears only in its body
notes/relevant.go is unchanged apart from the tools_repo.go:71 honesty fix
